title.en: To the Tune Busuanzi: Ode to the Plum

edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource; the variant readings it marks are left out. Lines broken at the punctuation for reading; text unchanged.
edition.zh: 据维基文库，删去其所注异文。按标点分行，文字未改。

basis.en: Song dynasty lyric (ci); the author died in 1210.

note.en: The plum, which opens alone in the cold before any other flower, was Lu You’s lifelong emblem of integrity, and he wrote about it again and again. Here it grows unowned beside a broken bridge, and the poem refuses to pity it. Wikisource gives the lyric under its tune name alone; it is usually known by the subtitle used here.
note.zh: 梅花在严寒中先于百花独自开放，是陆游一生反复书写的品格象征。这首词里，它无主地开在断桥边，词人并不怜悯它。维基文库只以词牌名“卜算子”收录此词；通常它以“咏梅”为题流传。

pick.en: The last two lines are why this is on my shelf: fallen, crushed into mud, ground to dust, and only the fragrance is as it was. It is the clearest statement I know of what this library hopes is true, that something of a person or a work can outlast its form. The poem is not sentimental about it. The plum is lonely, rained on and broken, and the scent stays anyway.
pick.zh: 最后两句是它在我书架上的原因：零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故。这是我所知道最清楚的说法，说出了这座图书馆希望为真的事：一个人或一件作品的某些东西，可以比它的形体存在得更久。这首词并不煽情。梅花孤独，被风雨打，被碾碎，香气却还在。

excerpt.orig: 零落成泥碾作塵，只有香如故。
excerpt.en: Fallen, crushed to mud and ground to dust, / only its fragrance stays as it was.
excerpt.zh: 零落成泥碾作尘，只有香如故。

gloss.en: Outside the post station, where official couriers changed horses.
gloss.zh: 驿：驿站，古代供传递公文的人和来往官员中途换马、歇宿的地方。

gloss.en: With no owner: no one tends it or comes to look.
gloss.zh: 无主：无人过问、无人欣赏。

gloss.en: 著, read zhuó: to be struck by, to suffer.
All the other flowers, those of spring.
Ground into dust, as under cart wheels.

marginalia.en: The first stanza piles hardship on hardship: alone, at dusk, and then wind and rain as well. 更, ‘and on top of that’, does the piling.
marginalia.zh: 上阕层层加码：孤独，黄昏，再加风雨。“更”字就是在加码。

marginalia.en: The plum flowers before spring, so it is not competing: by the time the others open it has fallen. The jealousy belongs to the other flowers; the plum has no part in it.
marginalia.zh: 梅花开在春天之前，本就不在争春；等百花开时，它已经谢了。嫉妒属于群芳，与梅花无关。
